name: team_vince
caption:
IF THE VINSANITY ERA WERE POKÉMON 🎮🏀

🔥 Vince Carter = Blaziken: clears a 30-story building in one leap. 27.6 a night in 2000-01
🦎 Tracy McGrady = Grovyle: astounding jumps, and nobody catches a fleeing Grovyle. 1.9 blocks a night in 1999-00, then he left for Orlando
🌊 Morris Peterson = Horsea: shoots down bugs with precision blasts of ink. 38.2% from three as a rookie
🦈 Chris Bosh = Gible: get too close and it pounces. 7.4 boards a night as a rookie
🗿 Loren Woods = Golurk: built to protect, follows orders faithfully. 4.9 boards a night

That's a team we're taking into any gym in the league. Who would you change? 👇

Monster sprites: PMD Sprite Collab (sprites.pmdcollab.org), CC BY-NC 4.0

beats.vo: If the Vinsanity era were Pokemon,
Its legs are so strong, it can clear a thirty-story building in one leap.
beats.dlg: IT CLEARS A 30-STORY|BUILDING IN ONE LEAP.

beats.vo: That's Vinsanity. Twenty-seven point six a night in twenty oh one, a career high.
Its thigh muscles give it astounding jumping, and no Pokemon can catch a fleeing Grovyle.
beats.dlg: AMAZING JUMPS. NO ONE CAN|CATCH A FLEEING GROVYLE.

beats.vo: Vince's cousin, starting next to him. One point nine blocks a night... then he fled to Orlando.
It shoots down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink.
beats.dlg: IT SHOOTS DOWN BUGS WITH|PRECISION BLASTS OF INK.

beats.vo: Mo Pete as a rookie, starting next to Vince. Thirty-eight point two percent from three.
beats.dlg: MO PETE, ROOKIE YEAR:|38.2% FROM THREE!

beats.vo: Foes who get too close can expect to be pounced on and bitten.
Bosh as a rookie: seven point four boards a night, leading all rookies in rebounds and blocks.
beats.dlg: BOSH, ROOKIE YEAR:|7.4 REBOUNDS A NIGHT!

beats.vo: It was built to protect people, and it follows its master's orders faithfully.
Seven-foot-one, starting at center next to Vince. Four point nine boards a night.
That's a team we're taking into any gym in the league.
beats.dlg: A TEAM WE'RE TAKING INTO|ANY GYM IN THE LEAGUE.

facts.claim: 3P% = three-point (3) field goal percentage, as listed by ESPN
In 2000-01, his third season, Carter averaged a career-high 27.6 points per game
Carter and his second cousin once removed, Tracy McGrady, were teammates in Toronto 1998-2000; McGrady left in free agency to the Orlando Magic in August 2000
Peterson was selected 21st overall by the Raptors in the 2000 NBA draft and was a starter in the majority of their games during his first three seasons
Bosh as a rookie (2003-04): 11.5 points, 7.4 rebounds, 1.4 blocks, leading all rookies in rebounding and blocks
Loren Woods: listed height 7 ft 1 in (7-1); Toronto Raptors 2004-2006
November 5, 2004: Raptors starters Chris Bosh, Loren Woods, Rafer Alston, Jalen Rose, Vince Carter
Blaziken flavor text: it can easily clear a 30-story building in one leap
